- **rule**: all applicable reasons retained in lexical order; status follows the first applicable reason in precedence; a value is null exactly when the status is not available; available implies observed == expected
- **counts**:
  - **window_outputs**: expected = declared coverage count; observed = delivered rows minus rows not ready inside the output's row closure; 0 when a required column is not delivered; 0 and 0 with no batch
  - **sign_based_outputs**: as above over every row from the open to C, plus a seed slot (expected +1, observed +1 when the seed is ready) when seed_policy is supplied
  - **top_k**: expected = declared coverage count; observed = delivered rows minus rows not ready; 0 when price or size is not delivered while eligible rows exist (this convention is specific to the new producers; the counts of the existing size-ranked output are unchanged)
  - **merged**: sum over partials
- **unreachable_reasons**:
  - null_field
  - ineligible
  - future_market
  - partial_universe
  - no_eligible_observations
  - empty_universe
- **evidence**:
  - **window**: seed:<reference_id> first when policy supplied and the output is sign-based, then trade:<event_id> of eligible in-window prints in canonical order, cut to evidence_limit; boundary ordinary
  - **top_k**: trade:<event_id> of the retained rows in rank order; boundary closing_auction for a print at event_ns == C with condition closing_auction, else ordinary; at most min(K, n) <= evidence_limit rows, no truncation
  - **unavailable**: none
